preserved_first_failure.description: The initial 00 coefficient assertion substituted q after expansion, so q remained independent of beta dot beta. The corrected assertion uses beta dot beta directly.

assumptions: Metric eta=diag(-1,1,1,1); source rest B=diag(0,D), D a fixed real symmetric 3x3 matrix; A(p)=0.
beta is real, q=beta dot beta with 0<=q<1; t=sqrt(1-q)>0, gamma=1/t>0, and a=gamma^2/(gamma+1).
Spatial Euclidean dot product; observer-null K=(-1,n), with n dot n=1 for the null interpretation.
exact_results: gamma^2(1-q)=1 and a q=gamma-1 on the positive square-root branch; gamma+1>0.
For Lambda=[[gamma,gamma beta^T],[gamma beta,I+a beta beta^T]], Lambda^T eta Lambda=eta. Lambda e0=(gamma,gamma beta) is future timelike.
(Lambda^T diag(0,D) Lambda)_{0i}=gamma((D beta)_i+a beta_i beta^T D beta), hence dipoleMap_i=-2 times this component.
method: SymPy exact symbolic finite-matrix expansion over six independent real entries of symmetric D and three independent beta entries, followed by rational normalization identities and a positive t parameterization. No numerical-only check or sibling result was used.
claim_ceiling: Exact finite canonical-boost and optical dipole map at one event under the stated rest tensor, symmetry and subluminal domain only.
excluded: Einstein matter realization or complete G03-C
historical four-axis promotion or scientific admission
next_obligation: Independent reviewer checks exact branch, signs, tensor definition and final script hash; nonlinear remainder and bounded Taylor estimate remain separate.
